2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Hello Buoy and Gurl!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: Hello sir!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Buoy
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: How do you know our names?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: I had a chat with your dad. He's super busy, so he's asked me to help you build a snowman!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: Really? We get to make a snowman?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Yes! And I'm going to build whatever snowman you want!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Buoy
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Yay! Can it be three snowballs tall?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: But I want it to be five tall!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Buoy
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Five is a bad number, it should be three tall!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: You're a bad number. Five is so much better.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Okay, okay, wait a second. Why don't we meet in the middle. How about four snowballs tall?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Buoy and Gurl think for a second.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: Fine, it can be four tall.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Buoy
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Yes, four tall is okay.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Great. Now, we need to pick what size snowballs we want for each tier. Why don't you take it in turns? You can do two each.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: The bottom one should be a huge snowball!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Buoy
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: The next one should be big!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: This is working nicely, we're half way! What about the top two parts?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: The next one should be a small snowball!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Buoy
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: No, it should be little!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: But it needs to be small, little would look bad.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Buoy
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: It wouldn't look bad. Small is better for decorations.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: My decorations will fit on a little one.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Buoy
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Why do you always ruin everything?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: You ruin everything with your silly ideas!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Okay, okay, wait. This clearly isn't working, and I don't want you two to fall out. It's Christmas, we shouldn't be arguing!
How about I make you both a snowman? It can be whatever height and size you like. One each!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: So mine can be five snowballs tall?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Buoy
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: And mine can be three snowballs tall?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Yes, I'll make you both whatever snowman you like!
What would you both like?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Buoy
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: I'd like mine to be three snowballs tall please! And I want the bottom one to be small, the middle one big, and the top one huge!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: I'd like mine to be five snowballs tall please! I want the bottom one to be humongous, then large, then normal, then big, and then a little one for the top!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: That's two very different snowmen, I see why this didn't work before!
What do all these different sizes mean? Humongous? Normal? Little? How big are those?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: You silly billy! Humongous is the biggest snowball of course!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Buoy
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Normal is the normal size that you get when you make a snowball normally. It's easy!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Right, thank you for clearing that up. I'll figure something out.
What are you two going to do for decorations?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Buoy
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: I already know what I want mine to look like!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: Me too!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Why don't you guys find some decorations while I build the snowmen? Then you can add them once I'm done.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Buoy
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Okay sir!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: We will do that!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Buoy and Gurl go back to playing in the snow.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Well, that seems sorted. I should speak to Larry again, and see if he has any advice about building the snowmen.
Hello there!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Buoy
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Have you started making the snowmen yet?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: You should talk to dad if you need some help, he knows how to make snowmen!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Buoy
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Yeah, he always used to make really big ones with us!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Maybe I'll go talk to him and see what advice he has.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: He'll say, make them really tall!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Buoy
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: He'll say make them shorter, because that's better!
Buoy and Gurl wander off, arguing about what size snowman is the best.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: I should go and speak to Larry. I'm sure he has some handy advice for me!

2021-christmas-event-making-snowmen.speaker: Buoy/Gurl
2021-christmas-event-making-snowmen.text: That looks good! It needs a [size] snowball next!

2021-christmas-event-when-finished-build.npc: Yay! Can we decorate them now?

2021-christmas-event-when-finished-build.speaker: Buoy
2021-christmas-event-when-finished-build.text: Yes! Can we decorate them now please [player name]?

2021-christmas-event-when-finished-build.player: Of course you can. Are they what you wanted?

2021-christmas-event-when-finished-build.speaker: Buoy
2021-christmas-event-when-finished-build.text: Mine too. It's just how I wanted it.

2021-christmas-event-when-finished-build.player: I am happy to hear that. It was harder work than I thought.

2021-christmas-event-when-finished-build.npc: You did a good job. Thank you very much [sir/madam].

2021-christmas-event-when-finished-build.player: It was no problem. Merry Christmas to you both!

2021-christmas-event-when-finished-build.text: Buoy and Gurl go to their snowmen to start decorating.

2021-christmas-event-when-finished-build.player: I should go and speak to Larry. Hopefully he has that festive white wine ready for me.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Those snowmen look amazing!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Buoy
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Thank you! Decorating them was quite hard!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: Yeah, they took ages to do! Do you like mine?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: It's really good! Reminds me of something actually.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Buoy
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: What about mine? Do you like it?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: I like yours too. They both remind me of something!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: Mine is Thermy! My favourite monster! She's so big and scary, makes me go woah!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Buoy
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Mine is Tempy! My favourite monster! He lives in the water, a huge mass of angry wet!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: They're both amazing! I didn't know you guys would be so good at decorating.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: Dad lets us decorate every year. We get a lot of practice!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Buoy
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Last year we made them into the Fragment of Seren and the King Black Dragon!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: What... really??? I'd like to have seen that. Those sound even more difficult than these two!
How do you know all these monsters anyway? There is no way your dad would let you anywhere near them!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Buoy
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Dad reads us lots of stories, and we hear about them from passing adventurers, like you.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: You must meet some interesting and cool adventurers!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: Not as cool as you though; none of them helped us make our snowmen!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Buoy
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Yes, you're the first to help us make them!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Well, you're welcome. I really enjoyed it. What are you guys going to do now you're finished?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: We're going to go and play! And maybe visit the festival. Will you be there?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: I sure will be. Maybe see you there!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Buoy
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Bye sir, Merry Christmas.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Merry Christmas, have fun!
